headline: TSMC Plans Massive 12-Fab and 4-Packaging Plant Expansion in Arizona, Solidifying US Semiconductor Leadership
summary: This unprecedented investment by TSMC fundamentally reshapes global semiconductor manufacturing, dramatically diversifying advanced chip production away from Asia and significantly bolstering US supply chain resilience. The colossal expansion directly boosts domestic AI infrastructure capabilities and signifies a major geopolitical shift in high-tech production amidst intensifying global tech competition.
